bf04.framing: High bit of uint32 length denotes extended branding frame. Unflagged remains 65536. Extended requests only company.brand-set; replies only brand-get/set.

brand.name: 0-48 Unicode scalars, no control or surrounding whitespace
brand.logo: PNG/JPEG/WebP data URI, at most 2MiB decoded and 4096 per dimension

equipment.interfaces: At most 128 static interfaces, complete/limited with eligible and dynamic counts; dynamic rows excluded; parts have separate timestamps, failures preserve prior snapshot as stale
equipment.restart: Read jobs have active-only replay; after restart no automatic retry. Durable mutation receipts retain replay. Latest interrupted attempt remains visible.

view_fields.total_devices: company total independent of filter, activity and page
view_fields.operation_state: COMMITTED or NOT_FOUND for creation reconciliation; NOT_FOUND is not cancellation
view_fields.vault_available: provider and existing company envelope ready

equipment.trust: Explicit first acceptance, bound to company/device/address/port/revision/key; local UID/time recorded by daemon; historical origin preserved without reclassification

provider_capability.meaning: configured provider available; does not prove company ciphertext readiness

pppoe.ledger: equipment_operations:2048 durable mutations, never pruned. Reads replay only while active; latest attempt per device/scope; migration7 removes only canonical historical read stamps and records counts.
pppoe.incomplete: attempt metadata only; preserve previous good current
pppoe.export: pppoe-sanitized-v1; native picker; ephemeral export_key never bound to JS; rows/comparison projection

diagnostics.ping_revalidation: exact tuple/login, unique IP and conservative uptime bounds in final command; no60s TTL
diagnostics.counter_encoding: unsigned decimal strings; preserve integers beyond JS safe range
diagnostics.storage: migration7 (preserves migration6 data); one current per device/scope, bounded attempt, shared A+B logical quota; no automatic history
diagnostics.context: IPv4 unicast from current immutable session; same daemon epoch; revalidate IDs/IP/uptimes; main only without custom VRF/rules/output mangle; v6 routing-table=main, v7 vrf=main
diagnostics.privacy: router-side allowlisted projections; no secret, raw log, whole config, debug or reset; no inferred per-session VLAN or rejection cause
diagnostics.export: freeze diagnostic IDs/scope/source; sanitize before IPC; shared16386aliases/2MiB; revalidate pages and publication

pppoe.session_context: optional stable context; unique login/caller/IP/uptime association; no rates; migration8 additive index; unavailable never zero; optional enrichment yields to base sessions at SSH/row/observation/company budgets; observation.context_omitted=true marks omission; context-counts returns current marker without asserting groups; CSV contexto column discloses omission; secret_state active/disabled/ambiguous/none/unavailable; profile only for active unique local secret; dynamic queue limit upload/download order; legacy missing state never attributes active profile

limited_reads.read_receipts: active job only; no SQL mutation
limited_reads.live_samples: last pair only; approximately2s; cumulative SSH512KiB/job
limited_reads.cancel: job_id OR exact device_id+operation_id; own scope only
limited_reads.top: explicit two counter snapshots of all running tunnels; no observation or row IDs; known lower bounds first; cost commands/bytes/duration/CPU samples
limited_reads.log: current immutable row/login only; last50 projected time/category; exact token/tunnel regex; excludesdebug; never raw log; SSH32KiB; no export
limited_reads.health: device-only; two samples of static interfaces; revalidate dated link/name/type after counters; pool scalar size/used only; unavailable distinct from zero; uint64 errors/drops as decimal strings
limited_reads.wire_shape: read.rows always array including empty; serialization sizes measured at adapter; service enforces512KiB/row2048B/meta16KiB
limited_reads.secret: exact selected current row/login only; at most4 secrets; disabled/service/profile/last-logged-out/last-caller-id/last-disconnect-reason/comment only; no password/map; absent fields unavailable; comment control-free and max128 characters; 20s/SSH32KiB; memory only/no SQL or exports
limited_reads.operations: migration11 adds 7day per-VLAN/service count samples; unknown membership never fabricates0; scope duplicates requires both ages<=15min and overlapping collection windows; ping jitter plus previous10 successful3/3 means in bounded service memory, not SQL history; inventory projects dated health snapshot; IPC13 adds fasttrack_rules and typed port/before_port; migration10 saves current snapshot and port/restart events30d within existing logical20MiB/shared160MiB, no rates; exact human-proved FastTrack/ethernet scripts share20s job; role-neutral DeviceHealth; demand only/minute bucket; resources, projected services/packages/clock/counters/auth counts, no raw messages; migration9 retains min/max/last sessions24h minute+6days hour; transitions24h; logical20MiB within shared160MiB; base readings take priority
limited_reads.traffic: same live60s budget; immutable 5s plot bins, uint64 byte totals and conservative covered-time average, sampled peak; stop retains final result, cancel discards; traffic cache300s within32 shared jobs

collector_failures.meaning: recognized RouterOS parser diagnostic; InfraDesktop collector incompatible with firmware, never unavailable
collector_failures.reason: closed structural enum from equipment.ValidCollectorReason; never remote text
